## Checklist

- [ ] Follows the [coding standards](https://github.com/carlelieser/directmetal/blob/main/docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md).
- [ ] Contains no code copied or translated from LGPL/GPL code (Wine, vkd3d, vkd3d-proton, DXMT).
- [ ] Tests follow [ADR 0007](https://github.com/carlelieser/directmetal/blob/main/docs/adr/0007-testing-strategy.md); bug fixes include a regression test that fails without the fix.
- [ ] One logical change per commit; every commit builds and passes tests.
